releaseNotes:
The native-feel update: springy press feedback and staggered entrances everywhere, a breathing glass glow, double-tap the cover to like (heart burst), a slow cinematic drift on the player artwork, and swipe hints on the mini player.
Four home-screen widgets: Player, Compact, Big Artwork and Quick Play (Liked / Offline / Radio / Discover) — long-press your Home screen → Widgets → Nokiatis MUC.
Background playback hardened: the player now stays in Active apps, survives swiping the app away while playing, and Settings can grant the unrestricted-battery exemption that stops Samsung from killing it.
New liquid-glass app icon.
